profile.headline: Sr. Principal Software Engineer at Ampere
profile.summary:
12+ years of kernel firmware development experience in wide range of technologies:
- Development of Silicon tape-out ROM, Firmware, Boot loaders (U-Boot, ARM TF, UEFI), Linux
device drivers.
- Development of BMC (AMI MegaRAC) for ARM64 server.
- Board bring up, boot up sequence and Secure Boot.
- System benchmarking, performance analysis and tuning (CPU, cache/memory subsystem, I/O,
offload engine)
- Kernel open-source patch submission.
- Design and develop DDR3/ DDR4 library with various features, new technologies.
- Debugging and resolving technical issues (Silicon Core, IPs, system level).

Technical Skills:
- Architecture: ARM64, ARM32, PowerPC.
- Protocol: DDR4, ARM SPCI/MM, I2C/SPI, PCIE, Ethernet, RAID storage.
- Programming Language: C, Python, Shell scripting.
- Debugger/Development Tool: GDB, Open OCD, BDI, Trace32, Cadence Verdi/nWave for
RTL/waveform silicon debug, Perf, Valgrind, OpenSSL.
- Protocol Analyzers: Beagle I2C/SPI, Wireshark, IXIA.

positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead BMC (using AST2500) software team for bug fixes, porting, supporting enhanced AMI MegaRAC features for eMAG ARM64 server: Redfish, JavaSOL, HTML5, UEFI SMBIOS table replication, USB device for in-band Redfish support.
•	Define test plan for BMC features.
•	Perform various system benchmarking for X-Gene3 product (LMbench, Drhystone, SPECCPU2006, SPECCPU2017, SPECJBB, SPECJVM, NVME FIO, Cassandra, HHVM, Sysbench)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Key contributor of eMAG Technical Software Design spec, defines software component communications, hardware resource allocation and features. 
•	Develop Boot-loaders, Media Boot (SATA, MMC, USB boot), Secure Boot for ARM64/PPC4xx in both pre-Sil and post-Sil. In charge of ROM development for chip tape-out. 
•	TechLead of BMC firmware project. Implement features using AMI MegaRAC SDK. In charge of all the software related aspects of BMC firmware, board bring-up, including testing. Drivers (GPIO, I2C, SPI, PWM, USB, PCIE, Ethernet), platform features (event logging, sensors, SOL, Firmware Upgrade, Backup Image, Failsafe SPI NOR, Cooling manager alg., IPMI, vKVM, vMedia, Redfish, SOL, …).
•	Developed X-Gene Gen1/Gen2 DDR3 library that supports 16 DIMM slots.
•	Successfully submitted the very first ARM64 PMU perf driver to the Linux kernel.
•	Develop System/Power Management Co-Processors Firmware, PM features (RAPL, TPC, AVS).
•	Develop SoC device drivers (I2C/SPI, DDR, PCIE, SDIO, Ethernet, SATA). Porting 3rd party device drivers to ARM64 Linux (PMC SAS controller, LSI SAS controller).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop NAS storage products over Wifi and Ethernet. Porting various 3rd vendor wireless, ethernet drivers to APM PowerPC Linux. Develop NAS Root file system (BusyBox, OpenWRT).
•	Develop RAID storage offload engine kernel driver, Async-DMA XOR/PQ/MEMCPY engines to relax CPU usage and boost overall NAS performance.
•	Develop device drivers for RTOS VxWork.
•	Analyze, profile to determine performance issue, bottleneck in data-path and optimize for performance.  Conduct CPU, memory, I/O (ethernet, storage) stress testing and benchmarking.
